agent_result:
In Age of Empires IV, the Japanese civilization in Age 4 can choose between two strategic paths:
1. Boosting trade — represented by the Castle of the Crow. This acts as a Keep and generates Treasure Caravans that can trade at any Trade Post by land or water, supporting economic development through active trade networks and resource generation from commerce.
2. Cultivating gunpowder weaponry — represented by the Tanegashima Gunsmith. This provides access to an arsenal of gunpowder units including the Ozutsu (heavy ranged infantry with a handheld cannon), shifting development toward military strength with siege and area-damage capabilities against buildings and clustered units.
These choices define late-game specialization: one focuses on economic/trade growth, the other on gunpowder-based military power.
